title: Qualify exact dw.quantities.standard NuGet candidate against two independently published Math dependencies
commitMessage: test: qualify Standard NuGet candidate with two exact dependencies

contribution.summary: Qualify a new dw.quantities.standard calendar-version NuGet candidate with exact pinned dependencies on both independently published Math packages and ten binary-only consumer checks.
contribution.value: Link five unchanged Standard sources in a temporary packaging project, use shared NuGet F1 version and package reader, confirm exact nuspec dependency closure, three DLL SHA-256 values, 250 g = 1/4 kg and explicit ambiguity handling.
debtChanges: The historical Standard source package stays at 0.2.0-preview.1 with two ProjectReference edges; only a disposable packaging projection substitutes exact PackageReferences.
RS141 creates an unreserved, unpublished calendar candidate; immutable NUGET_LOCAL publication and independently qualified readback require later separate gates.
Public licensing, package notices, installed-package rollback, other OS/RID platforms and Discovery/Decision integration remain outside the qualification.
The RS140 predecessor succeeded at allocated attempt 001 after one pre-attempt refusal; its run-level first-pass is NO, and historical publication receipts are retained unchanged.
contribution.nextAction: After RS141 succeeds, examine the dynamic Standard candidate and two exact source-independent dependency DLL hashes; qualify a disposable shared NuGet publisher rehearsal before separately authorized local publication and DWF readback.
